packages.name: chematic-core
packages.description: Core types (Atom, Bond, Molecule) for chematic — pure-Rust RDKit alternative, WASM-compatible

packages.name: chematic-smiles
packages.description: OpenSMILES parser, writer and canonical SMILES for chematic — pure Rust, WASM-compatible

packages.name: chematic-perception
packages.description: SSSR ring perception and Hückel aromaticity for chematic — pure-Rust RDKit alternative

packages.name: chematic-fp
packages.description: ECFP4/6, MACCS 166-bit and topological path fingerprints with Tanimoto/Dice similarity for chematic

packages.name: chematic-cip
packages.description: Low-level accurate CIP (Cahn-Ingold-Prelog) digraph engine for chematic -- most applications should use chematic_chem::assign_cip_with_mode instead. Experimental, may have breaking 0.x changes.

packages.name: chematic-chem
packages.description: Molecular descriptors: MW, LogP, TPSA, QED, Gasteiger charges, CIP stereo, Murcko scaffold, tautomers, BRICS fragmentation — pure-Rust

packages.name: chematic-iupac
packages.description: Local IUPAC name generation for chematic — pure-Rust, no network required

packages.name: chematic-smarts
packages.description: SMARTS parser, VF2 subgraph isomorphism and MCS for chematic — pure-Rust RDKit alternative

packages.name: chematic-rxn
packages.description: Reaction SMILES/SMIRKS parser and writer for chematic — pure-Rust RDKit alternative

packages.name: chematic-mol
packages.description: MOL/SDF V2000 and V3000 parser and writer for chematic — pure-Rust RDKit alternative

packages.name: chematic-3d
packages.description: 3D coordinate generation, DREIDING force field, velocity Verlet MD, PDB/XYZ I/O, conformer RMSD — pure Rust, WASM-compatible

packages.name: chematic-ff
packages.description: DREIDING force field atom typing and parameters for chematic — pure-Rust cheminformatics

packages.name: chematic-crystal
packages.description: Periodic crystal structure representation and geometry (lattice, fractional/Cartesian coordinates, PBC distance, periodic neighbors, supercells) for chematic -- pure Rust, WASM-compatible

packages.name: chematic-depict
packages.description: 2D molecular structure depiction as SVG: ring templates, wedge/dash stereo bonds, CPK coloring, grid layout — pure-Rust, no C/C++ dependencies

packages.name: chematic-ewald
packages.description: Smooth Particle Mesh Ewald (SPME) electrostatics: real-space erfc Coulomb, reciprocal-space FFT, periodic boundary conditions — pure Rust

packages.name: chematic-inchi
packages.description: Pure Rust InChI/InChIKey generation (WASM-compatible) + optional IUPAC-standard InChI via native-inchi feature

packages.name: chematic-wasm
packages.description: WebAssembly bindings for chematic — use chematic from JavaScript/TypeScript

packages.name: chematic
packages.description: A pure-Rust cheminformatics toolkit: SMILES/SMARTS, SDF/MOL V3000, ECFP/MACCS fingerprints, LogP/TPSA/QED, CIP stereo, MCS, 2D SVG depiction — no C/C++ dependencies, runs in the browser via WebAssembly.

packages.name: chematic-mcp
packages.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for chematic — AI-agent-ready cheminformatics tools

packages.name: chematic-cli
packages.description: Small command-line interface for common chematic molecule conversions

packages.name: chematic-py
packages.description: Python bindings for chematic — pure-Rust cheminformatics

packages.name: gen-sa-table
packages.description: Offline tool: generates the SA Score fragment frequency table from a SMILES corpus
